visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair and bangs stands outdoors in a bright, sunny environment with palm trees and a swimming pool in the background. She wears a black sleeveless top and smiles vibrantly at the camera. (2) The scene shifts to a dormitory room featuring two twin beds with tan linens, light-colored walls, and a wooden wardrobe unit. (3) Outside at dusk, a group of women in athletic wear are dancing in front of a modern building with holiday decorations. (4) Back in daylight, the woman gestures towards a blue swimming pool with a large sign that reads 'I.BREEZE International Language Center'. (5) A hallway with glass doors leads to small classrooms. Inside, the woman sits at a desk with a male teacher, surrounded by books and notebooks under bright fluorescent lighting. (6) In a large cafeteria with wooden tables, a buffet line displays various trays of food including fried chicken, stir-fried noodles, and leafy greens. (7) The woman is seen in a gym setting, lifting dumbbells while wearing blue athletic leggings and a sports bra. (8) At night, the woman is seen in a social dining area chatting with other students of various ethnicities. (9) Close-up shots of dorm amenities include a mini-fridge, a small safe inside a wooden cabinet, and a black hairdryer being held by the woman in a bathroom with marble-patterned tiles. (10) An outdoor covered area shows a row of top-loading washing machines and plastic laundry baskets. (11) A flat lay shows a variety of snacks, water bottles, and stationery items arranged on a table with branding for 'Outback'.

The BGM remains constant, maintaining a cheerful tempo. (3) During the cafeteria segment, a low-level ambient murmur of voices and clinking utensils is heard beneath the narration, providing context of a busy dining environment. (4) A transition SFX, a light 'whoosh', occurs as the scene moves to the gym. The sound of a metal weight clinking is briefly audible. (5) As the narrator discusses social activities, background laughter and more prominent multi-person chatter are mixed in, reinforcing the social theme. (6) The dorm tour section features a clear, informative vocal delivery with subtle 'pop' SFX for each mentioned amenity. The BGM fades out gently at the very end.
